page.notes: Page opens with a fragment: the first letter of "mentio" is cut off at the left edge. The Greek words "Anthropo", "Logon", "Zoen" and "Anthropon", "Anthropos" are printed in an italic face with a decorative initial; they are transcribed as they appear, but the originals may be Greek (Ἄνθρωπος, Λόγος, Ζωή) and should be checked. "consequitur" has a gap in the print ("conf quitur"), read as consequitur[?]. The word "Hiriolari" is printed as such. The gathering signature is "Dd ij". The Google watermark at the lower right is excluded.
